content: RNN-based encoder-decoder models BIBREF20 , BIBREF21 have been widely used for natural language generation tasks. Here we consider a recently proposed generative model BIBREF22 that first encodes the context and question into a multi-perspective memory via four different neural matching layers, then decodes the answer using an attention-based model equipped with both copy and coverage mechanisms. The model is trained on our dataset for 15 epochs and we choose the model parameters that achieve the best BLEU-1 score on the development set.
